frames.visible_job: Attach a narrow upright shaft to the oval center and cap it with one small round knob. Keep the knob directly above the pointed tip.

frames.visible_job: Sweep two open motion strokes beside each side and one broken oval shadow below the tip.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved JPG contains one wide slightly tilted rim oval attached to two tapering body sides that meet at a single centered point. Its large connected silhouette gives a beginner the top shape before decorative bands, knob, or color.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I inspected the corrected six-panel sheet and every adjacent pair of saved crops. The rim endpoints, centered point, shaft-to-rim attachment, round knob, two curved band boundaries, three downward triangles, one upper-right band shine, four side motion arcs, and broken oval shadow stay in their intended places. No guides appear or disappear; the final crop fills established regions with streaky marker and adds no white highlight shape.

transitions.observed_addition: The rim oval and tapered sides keep their original ends and centered point. One narrow shaft attaches at the oval center and one round knob caps it directly above the point.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 2 asks for the centered attached shaft and round cap; both are new, and the original wide rim and tapered body remain unchanged.

transitions.observed_addition: The centered shaft, knob, rim, and pointed body persist. One curved upper band appears below the rim and one lower curved band appears above the point, both following the same tapered body.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 3 names two curved bands in those exact locations; the saved frame adds the pair without redrawing the outer silhouette.

transitions.observed_addition: Both curved bands remain anchored. Exactly three filled downward triangles appear between them, and one unfilled oval shine reserve is outlined at the upper-right end of the top band.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 4 instructs three dark triangles with open gaps and a single band shine reserve; the crop shows that count and position.

transitions.observed_addition: The three triangles and band shine stay fixed. One long and one short open motion arc appear on each side, four strokes total. A broken oval shadow appears below the pointed tip with a white gap.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 5 asks for two side-arc pairs and the detached broken shadow; the crop contains those additions without the formerly promised but absent center shading.

transitions.observed_addition: The same rim, tapered point, centered shaft, round knob, two bands, three triangles, one band shine, four motion arcs, and broken shadow persist. Coral, teal, yellow, and navy marker fills the existing regions with visible paper streaks; no new white top or knob highlights appear.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction assigns coral to the top, teal to upper and lower bands, navy to the triangles, yellow to the gaps and knob, and yellow with dark teal sides to the shaft. It reserves only the pre-existing band shine.
